cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not approving the bin for our ferry ticket. Remember the overtime we worked for that weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may hate the ferry. We stayed anyway; that was the first time we chose each other over a refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's keep the hotel receipt in an envelope instead. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Substitution approved. Write 'that part was lovely' on the envelope in your handwriting. I want a record that it mattered to you too.
